points.quote: **Affine editor: `blocksuite/affine/`** This builds on the framework and holds these kinds of components
`store`: the Yjs-backed document and block model.
`std`: the runtime for block views, selection, and the canvas/gfx layer.
`widgets/`: UI overlays such as toolbar, slash-menu, drag-handle... `fragments/`: side panels such as outline, frame-panel, doc-title... The `root` block is the page and edgeless host.
`blocksuite/` imports nothing from outside itself. ... So the app consumes BlockSuite as a set of packages and customizes it through extensions rather than modifying it.
